card.name: Words inside all-caps headings
card.fires_on: Words in ALL-CAPS text, such as headings and warning titles, especially linking words (AND, OF, THE) and the ending of a capitalised medical word like MYASTHENIA.

modes.label: Linking words in caps headings
modes.description: A small linking word such as AND, OF or THE inside an all-caps heading.
modes.example: GEOGRAPHICAL RANGE<< AND>> HABITAT: Arid parts

modes.label: Ending of capitalised medical term
modes.description: The last part of a long capitalised medical word in a boxed warning heading.

card.writes: It seems to push the next piece to be another capital-letter word start, such as VI, AM, TI or CH.
card.plain: It fires inside shouting-style capital-letter headings, on small joining words or word endings, and expects more capitals to follow.
